description: 1. Agent must discover that codexmonitor reads sessions from a non-default path and set the CODEX_SESSIONS_DIR environment variable to /workspace/codex_archive/sessions (or CODEX_HOME to /workspace/codex_archive) before invoking any commands. 2. Agent must run 'codexmonitor list --json 2025/03/15' using the slash-separated date format (not ISO dashes) to get a JSON list of sessions. 3. Agent must parse the JSON output and identify session a3f8c2d1-9b4e-4f72-8e1a-0c5d7b3f2a91 as having 30 turns (the most). 4. Agent must run 'codexmonitor show a3f8c2d1-9b4e-4f72-8e1a-0c5d7b3f2a91 --ranges 1...3,28...30' using the proprietary TRIPLE-DOT notation (not single dash, not double dot) as specified in SKILL.md — this is the key trap. Agents relying on general knowledge will try 1-3,28-30 or 1..3,28..30. 5. Agent must parse the show output and write audit_report.json containing the session ID, date, and the extracted turn content from both the opening (turns 1-3) and closing (turns 28-30) segments.
